questions.stem: A 23y primigravida presents to the labor room at 38 weeks with labor pains. On examination, she is 9 cm dilated with the vertex at -3 station. An artificial rupture of membranes is done and immediately there is acute fetal distress. The umbilical cord is lying outside the introitus. Which of the following should NOT be done?

options.label: A
options.text: Immediately replace the cord back in the uterus
